import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import io

# Load the dataset
data = """
amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Pivot the data
pivot_df = df.pivot_table(index='hour_of_day', columns='transaction_type', values='amount', aggfunc='sum')

# Plot the data
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.heatmap(pivot_df, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', fmt='.2f')
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Hour of Day and Type')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Hour of Day')
